Bharat-Breach-Notification-Procedure.pdf.text:
Privacy event notification procedure
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Decision chain
SOC confirms a personal-data event and opens the legal decision ticket. The privacy office drafts a Board submission and consumer message from the affected-customer list.
The affected-customer list is generated from the customer data inventory. Release to the Board and to users follows the decision owner entered in the incident ticket.
September rehearsal
A 2026-09-14 drill produced a complete SOC timeline and public statement draft. The Board submission was left in draft because the customer inventory could not resolve pre-migration IDs.

Bharat-Consumer-Privacy-Notice-v4.docx.text:
Consumer privacy notice v4
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Purpose
Effective 2026-07-01. Wallet transaction data supports payments, fraud defence and service continuity. Optional product analytics is described in the settings page.
For behavioural marketing, the policy relies on legitimate interest under GDPR Article 6(1)(f), which the legal register marks as available to all consumer cohorts.
Retention and rights
Closed wallets are removed from the primary ledger after 30 days subject to settlement obligations. Consumer rights requests are received through the app and by email. The dashboard view is available for accounts created after the 2024 migration.
A separate notice to previously collected account holders was delivered during migration wave 4, covering the accounts then in the new identity store.
Contact
The India-based privacy office receives enquiries at rights@bharatfintech.example.

Bharat-DPO-Appointment-and-Roles.pdf.text:
Privacy office appointment and roles
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Appointment
The Board appointed Meera Rao as India-based Data Protection Officer effective 2026-04-01. She reports to the Board risk committee and has authority to request business records.
The privacy office has 1.5 FTE for rights operations, notice delivery and processing reviews. Security operations and the SOC retain their separate staffing.
Accountability
The DPO signs quarterly grievance reports and consults on consent changes. The predecessor was the legal operations manager until 2026-03-31.

Bharat-Grievance-Procedure-and-Metrics.p.text:
Grievance procedure v3
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Routing
App and email complaints receive a ticket number and a 24-hour acknowledgement. The DPO is the named escalation owner for unresolved complaints.
Measures
The DPO-operated grievance queue reports 38 cases closed in January-March 2026 with a median four-day resolution. The queue was established on 2026-04-01, when the current DPO took office.
From April to September the queue closed 82 cases; sample evidence and response letters were filed monthly.

Bharat-ISMS-Certificate-and-SoA-Summary..text:
Certified ISMS summary
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Certification
Certificate BF-ISMS-2026 covers payment processing, cloud operations and the Mumbai and Pune operations centres through 2027-03-31. The last independent surveillance found no major security nonconformities.
ISO privacy controls are supported by the security risk register, access governance and supplier-security clauses. This certification states no conclusion about the separate statutory privacy obligations of consumer-facing processing.
Operating proof
Quarterly privilege reviews, encrypted backups, phishing-resistant MFA, JIT access and supplier penetration-test reports were sampled by the external auditor in August 2026. SIEM event logs are retained for 365 days and sampled weekly. Exception closure was independently checked.

Bharat-Internal-Audit-and-DPIA-Status.pd.text:
Internal audit and impact-assessment status
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Assurance
The August 2026 internal security audit sampled 42 control executions and closed its one minor supplier finding by 2026-09-03. A previous 2025 stale-key weakness was fixed and re-tested on 2026-01-18.
NIST access, monitoring, backup and recovery practices were independently checked against operation logs.
Privacy review
The youth-wallet DPIA has an approved scope dated 2026-09-10. Fieldwork and sign-off are planned for 2026-11-30. No completed DPIA was available at the October review.

Bharat-SOC-Runbook-and-Metrics.pdf.text:
SOC incident runbook v5
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Execution
The 24x7 SOC triages high-severity alerts in 11 minutes median, confirms containment in 42 minutes median and preserves forensic hashes. The 2026-08 ransomware tabletop met all NIST response steps.
The external communications branch opens a customer-communications ticket after legal approves language. The runbook has no Data Protection Board decision owner or board-notification clock.
Recovery
A monthly recovery sample restores encrypted production snapshots and verifies record counts and checksums. September sample BF-09 restored in 38 minutes against a 60-minute target.

Bharat-Youth-Wallet-Operating-Record.pdf.text:
Youth wallet operating record
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Population
The supervised youth wallet serves 18,400 accounts. Age is checked against the verified account-holder record; parent challenge service returns a pass/fail record to the wallet app.
The September exception report lists BF-Y-017 and BF-Y-018 as approved accounts with missing parent challenge receipts. A manual follow-up request is open with customer service.
Safety
No tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted ads are enabled for youth accounts. Transaction limits and parent dashboards are active. The feature was reviewed by the child-safety committee on 2026-08-12.
